crew.overview: Years after his father disowns his adopted brother for marrying a woman of lower social standing, a young man goes on a mission to reunite his family.
crew.title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.

Punit Malhotra is an Indian film director. His first film, I Hate Luv Storys,released on 2 July 2010, was a big success in India (Budget:25 crores, Collection (amount received by Producer:over 60 cr). Before directing, he was also into modelling and has done a number of commercials and short films. He is the nephew of famous Indian designer Manish Malhotra. He is supposedly seeing Sonam Kapoor, the Bollywood actress according to media reports.
